summary: Dynamics Corner podcast clip on adopting Copilot with purpose. Speakers say the pace of change makes adoption hard, that new Copilot instructions, skills and agents felt overwhelming, and that starting with simple prompts and iterating worked.
overview:
A short clip from the Dynamics Corner podcast about using AI to solve real problems for customers and other people, rather than feeling pressure to use every new capability. The speakers say the rate of change is so fast that adoption is sometimes difficult.

One speaker describes feeling overwhelmed when Copilot instructions, skills and agents arrived. Their approach was to create something very simple and build from there. They now create prompts regularly.
key_points: Apply AI to solve problems for customers and other people, not because of pressure to use it.
The rate of change in Copilot is fast enough that adoption can be difficult.
Copilot instructions, skills and agents arriving close together left one speaker overwhelmed.
Start with something very simple, such as a basic custom prompt, and iterate.
Creating prompts for specific use cases becomes routine with practice.
